final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT AlbumId AS a, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.a AS a, s1.r AS r, s1.c AS c, s1.r - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.r > s2.m) SELECT AVG(r), AVG(c), AVG(d) FROM s3
